title: Week 26 Updates: MCP Login, Shell Mode Improvements, and Rewind
description: Added claude mcp login/logout commands for shell-based MCP authentication, shell mode now responds to command output automatically, /rewind can resume conversations from before /clear, and background subagents surface permission prompts in main session.

community_feedback.quote: I can no longer in good conscience recommend Claude Code
Claude Code and Opus quality regressions - serious performance degradation in Claude Code on MacOS since 22 June 2026
2026 Is Where It Gets Very Real Because Of Claude Code

title: Week 25: Artifacts Beta and Enhanced Auto Mode
description: Artifacts feature in beta on Team/Enterprise plans turns session output into live shareable pages. Enhanced deny/ask rules match tool parameters, /config sets settings from prompt, and auto mode blocks destructive git commands.

title: Week 24: /cd Command, Subagent Spawning, and Safe Mode
description: New /cd command moves sessions to new directories mid-conversation, subagents can now spawn their own subagents, --safe-mode starts with customizations disabled, and fallbackModel configures up to three fallback models.

title: Version 3.9: Custom Plugins, Skills, and MCP Integration
description: Released June 22, 2026. Added custom Cursor plugins, custom skills, and custom MCP (Model Context Protocol) integration. New 'Customization' page allows users to customize Cursor according to workflow needs.

title: Usage-Based Billing Now Live for All Plans
description: GitHub Copilot moved to usage-based billing on June 1, 2026. All plans now bill based on GitHub AI Credits consumed. Added user-level budget controls, Copilot Max upgrade for power users, and Copilot code review now consumes Actions minutes.

community_feedback.quote: End of an Era - GitHub Copilot became unusable for individual devs after the usage-based billing change
One developer reported their April 2026 usage would cost $14,064.55 more under usage-based billing compared to their current $910.98 bill
A user was charged $0.51 (51 AI credits) just to write a simple commit message and git push
I don't understand all the hate on the new usage-based billing

title: Service Discontinuation and Transition to Antigravity CLI
description: Google announced Gemini CLI will stop working from June 18, 2026, with a transition to Antigravity CLI. The June 2026 release included safer auto-updates, improved terminal and WSL handling, and faster core behavior.

community_feedback.quote: Gemini CLI was positioned as a direct competitor to Claude Code, a CLI-based coding agent

title: Wave 13 Update with Enhanced Memory System
description: Windsurf Wave 13 (2026) includes improved Cascade Memory System that remembers codebase structure and preferences. Windsurf is the rebranded name for Codeium, positioned as a free alternative to paid tools.

community_feedback.quote: Codeium was the free alternative. The tool you recommended to junior developers, students, or anyone who didn't want to pay $20/month

title: June 2026: Enterprise Features and MCP Expansion
description: Added session folders, !ultra and !fast Slack commands, enterprise snapshot build schedules, and 48+ new MCP connectors including Miro, Mixpanel, Honeycomb, Postman. Classic environment setup deprecated on June 30, 2026 in favor of declarative configuration.

title: Major Business Milestone: $492M ARR and $1B Funding
description: Devin hit $492M ARR in June 2026 (up from $73M in June 2025), and Cognition raised $1B at $26B valuation led by Lux Capital, General Catalyst, and 8VC. Introduced the 'Devin Guarantee' challenging traditional SaaS models. Devin now writes 89% of its own code.

community_feedback.quote: The third week of June 2026 was cited as completely rewriting the playbook for AI startups
AI coding is a $260B business opportunity and no longer experimental

title: June 2026: Performance Improvements and Enhanced Features
description: OpenAI Codex CLI released updates including usage views for token activity, richer /goal handling for large text and images, safer session deletion, and new /import command for bringing in Claude Code. Additional performance improvements and bug fixes released June 16, 2026.
